en: A colorized view of a European city with a river in the foreground crossed by a metal bridge, rows of historic buildings with red-tiled roofs, and a church tower with an onion-shaped dome. Behind the city rises a steep hill crowned by fortress walls and structures, with a prominent clock tower standing on the slope. Distant hills form the background. Printed caption text appears along the top edge.
